module_name: Agentic AI for Social Listening and Market Research
module_description: Module 14 covers agentic workflows: AI agents and connectors that plan, fetch, analyze and report (social-listening agents, MCP connectors, orchestration frameworks). It teaches how to build a reproducible multi-step research agent, evaluate outputs, and keep human oversight - the 2025-2026 skill shift for analysts from 'operating the tool' to 'specifying and auditing the agent'.
core_concepts: Agent architectures: planner, tools, memory, evaluation
MCP-style tool connectors and APIs for research pipelines
Failure modes: hallucinated numbers, silent scope drift
learning_outcomes: C3 Build a scripted agent pipeline for a listening question
C4 Audit agent output and quantify error
C5 Design oversight and logging for a research assistant
methods_models: Tool-use patterns, structured outputs, deterministic QA checks on numbers, evaluation harness for agent output
evaluation_metrics: Task-completion accuracy, hallucination rate, cost per completed task, time saved, reviewer agreement
pitfalls_limitations: Hallucinated metrics, scope creep, unreproducible non-determinism, cost overruns, opaque prompts and no logging
tools_stack: MCP servers, Claude/GPT SDKs with tool use, LangGraph/CrewAI, Python notebooks as deterministic fallback
commercial_platforms: Industry comparison: Pulsar/Talkwalker AI agents, Meta agentic business tools (2026 announcements)
tools_access_cost: Agent API costs scale with tool calls; keep deterministic steps in Python
lab_activities: Build a two-step agent (retrieve + summarize + chart) for a fixed question and audit its numeric claims
datasets_apis: Public data (Bluesky/Reddit) plus a fixed question brief
assessment_methods: Lab notebook submission plus a 1-page interpretation with error analysis; graded on correctness, interpretation and documentation
data_collection_workflow: Collect posts -> clean text -> build annotation/codebook (human + LLM) -> validate with kappa -> train/evaluate -> archive labelled data and prompts
textbooks: Insight Platforms guides on AI agents for researchers (2025-2026)
key_papers: 2025-2026 practitioner comparisons of social-listening AI agents
MRS training course on AI agents in market research (2026)
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: agentic analytics moved into market research products; the analyst job shifted to specification, evaluation and governance of agents
industry_relevance: Social media analyst, market-insights researcher, and data-journalist roles; this module is used for social listening, brand/issue monitoring, and audience research, and is referenced by industry certifications such as Meta Blueprint, Hootsuite Social Marketing, and Google Analytics.
localization_context: Taught with Indonesian-language material (IndoBERT/IndoRoBERTa/NusaBERT, InSet lexicon, Indonesian social datasets) so students can reproduce the analysis on local corpora; comparisons are made against Anglocentric benchmarks whose labels often transfer poorly.
ethics_regulation: Platform Terms of Service, UU PDP No. 27/2022 (Indonesian personal data protection), GDPR for EU-origin data, and IRB-style review for any data involving private individuals; public is not the same as consentable for social data.
case_study_scenarios: Automate a weekly brand-mention digest with an agent, then audit a week of its numbers.
